scope_limits: Current-package forecast routes. The fitted model SHA and actual per-head columns are recorded on each receipt. Declared policies describe the incumbent, without approving statistical thresholds.
historical_support: NBA, NHL, MLS and CFB preparation emits per-season pre-imputation counts for the deployment cohort. Normalized fields cannot establish provider publication or original-time coverage. Other cohorts and incomplete older packages have unknown support.
freshness: Current packages use the existing package and source TTL, as-of date and no-future-fit checks. Each row binds its cutoff, state, source references and semantic identity. Eligible-history recency may differ from source retrieval recency.

nba.source: Provider final histories; regular-season scope and eligible prior-day embargo

nhl.source: Provider final histories; fitted NHL season scope and eligible prior-day embargo. Contract settlement remains separately scoped.

mls.source: Provider final histories under regulation game scope; independent Poisson goal heads

cfb.source: Pinned FBS/FBS schedule and historical scores; week 1 has a separately registered model and is refused by the current packager. No fitted total.

wnba.source: Earlier season box scores and league aggregates, official-plus-one reconciliation and canonical team mapping

mlb.source: Official regular-season D-1 form, probable pitchers and earlier pitcher logs, or explicitly pinned legacy form and dated starter dispositions

groups.team_form: Home/away scoring for and against use fitted league prior when team absent; observed team state is blended by n/(n+10). All fitted heads.
groups.eligible_rest: Each side without last eligible start receives 14 days. Elapsed days are bounded to 0–14. Does not resolve real travel/last game. All fitted heads.
groups.early_history: Home and away cold flags indicate fewer than ten eligible games. All initial heads.
groups.neutral: Normalized neutral flag enters all initial heads; legacy parser substitutes false when provider field absent. Raw omission unresolved on older packages.
groups.packed_imputer: Each fitted column in each packed logistic/linear/Poisson head is ordered by the feature schema, replaces unavailable values with its own fit-time median, and applies own center, scale and coefficients.
groups.elo_prior: Previously unseen team rating defaults to 1500; existing rating regresses on season transitions. Both heads.
groups.ewma: Absent home or away points-for, points-against and margin state yield None; head-specific median replaces it. Both heads.
groups.cfb_rest: Difference is None if either last game is absent; both fitted heads impute.
groups.schedule_flags: Neutral site and conference-game booleans enter both heads. Provenance of a normalized false requires source readback.
groups.wnba_team_eligibility: Missing team season, fewer than the native minimum games or nonpositive possessions blocks all heads.
groups.wnba_shrinkage: Net rating shrinks by games/(games+SHRINK_G); enters winner, margin and total.
groups.wnba_rest: ET-date rest is capped at five; a one-day interval fires back-to-back. Winner and margin.
groups.wnba_rate_floor: Offensive rebound denominator floors available misses at one in four-factor features; winner and margin.
groups.wnba_league_state: League total and pace aggregates require nonzero eligible game count. Total head only.
groups.starter_profile: V13 substitutes 4.20 ERA, 22 K%, 8.5 BB% and zero starts; shrinks ERA by starts/(starts+8). A prior may reflect unknown identity, thin history or legacy staleness. Separate d_logistic_2f consumes shrunk ERA and team form only.
groups.form_default: V13 falsey team runs for/against fall back to 4.45; audit cannot distinguish every upstream substitution in legacy form.
groups.park_factor: Missing/falsey park values use neutral 1.0 on V13; no park field in d_logistic_2f.

team_form.source: Canonical home/away team state from earlier eligible final-score histories; fitted league prior.
team_form.freshness_requirement: Use only the bound package source/cutoff and TTL policy, with earlier eligible histories and no future fitted state. A current retrieval timestamp does not establish current sporting coverage.
team_form.missing_representation: Absent team state becomes n=0 and league-prior for/against values before the fitted vector; normalized numeric priors are not evidence of observed team form.
team_form.imputation_rule: Blend recorded form with the fitted league prior using n/(n+10); absent state therefore uses the prior. Any remaining None/NaN uses the head-specific fitted median.
team_form.missingness_indicator_usage: Indirect n-dependent shrinkage; separate home_cold/away_cold columns describe history count below ten.
team_form.fallback_or_refusal: Retain the incumbent research prior with explicit state; acquisition failure must be rejected upstream, not relabeled as observed history. A feature declaration does not certify the missingness pattern or approve fallback use for official selections.

eligible_rest.source: Last earlier eligible canonical game start for the specified team.
eligible_rest.freshness_requirement: Use only the bound package source/cutoff and TTL policy, with earlier eligible histories and no future fitted state. A current retrieval timestamp does not establish current sporting coverage.
eligible_rest.missing_representation: No last eligible start becomes 14 days before the fitted vector; this is not a verified 14-day real-world break.
eligible_rest.imputation_rule: Bound elapsed eligible-history rest to 0–14 days; use 14 when last start is absent. Any remaining None/NaN uses the head-specific fitted median.
eligible_rest.missingness_indicator_usage: No dedicated rest-missing indicator in this arm; the substituted value is an indirect missingness path.
eligible_rest.fallback_or_refusal: Retain disclosed 14-day research fallback; unresolved current schedule/coverage remains unresolved. A feature declaration does not certify the missingness pattern or approve fallback use for official selections.

early_history.source: Number of earlier eligible canonical games for the specified team in the current fitted state.
early_history.freshness_requirement: Use only the bound package source/cutoff and TTL policy, with earlier eligible histories and no future fitted state. A current retrieval timestamp does not establish current sporting coverage.
early_history.missing_representation: Absent team state uses n=0; this is not a verified absence of games.
early_history.imputation_rule: Emit 1 when n<10 and 0 otherwise; any None/NaN at the packed head uses its fitted median.
early_history.missingness_indicator_usage: Explicit history-support indicator consumed by each named head. It does not identify why history is short.
early_history.fallback_or_refusal: Keep the cold-history flag and its current provenance; do not infer collection success from the binary value. A feature declaration does not certify the missingness pattern or approve fallback use for official selections.

neutral.source: Normalized canonical schedule neutral-site field for the event.
neutral.freshness_requirement: Use only the bound package source/cutoff and TTL policy, with earlier eligible histories and no future fitted state. A current retrieval timestamp does not establish current sporting coverage.
neutral.missing_representation: Legacy parser can substitute false when provider field is absent; normalized false cannot distinguish omitted from verified false.
neutral.imputation_rule: Boolean normalization in the schedule transform; any None/NaN at the fitted head uses its fitted median.
neutral.missingness_indicator_usage: No dedicated missing-venue indicator; raw provider omission is an indirect unresolved path.
neutral.fallback_or_refusal: Expose normalized venue uncertainty; raw source readback is required to establish a substantive venue observation. A feature declaration does not certify the missingness pattern or approve fallback use for official selections.

elo_prior.source: Canonical earlier team Elo state, prior season marker, and normalized event venue.
elo_prior.freshness_requirement: Use only the bound package source/cutoff and TTL policy, with earlier eligible histories and no future fitted state. A current retrieval timestamp does not establish current sporting coverage.
elo_prior.missing_representation: Unseen team rating becomes 1500; an unknown last season skips season-change regression. These defaults precede the fitted vector.
elo_prior.imputation_rule: Use Elo 1500 for an absent team; regress an observed rating on a recorded season transition; add home advantage only when normalized neutral_site is false. None/NaN at the head uses its fitted median.
elo_prior.missingness_indicator_usage: No separate unseen-team or unknown-last-season indicator in this arm; both defaults are indirect missingness paths.
elo_prior.fallback_or_refusal: Retain disclosed incumbent Elo fallback; do not call unknown team history observed. A feature declaration does not certify the missingness pattern or approve fallback use for official selections.

ewma.source: Earlier canonical FBS/FBS points-for, points-against, or margin state for the specified team.
ewma.freshness_requirement: Use only the bound package source/cutoff and TTL policy, with earlier eligible histories and no future fitted state. A current retrieval timestamp does not establish current sporting coverage.
ewma.missing_representation: Absent state yields None; observed zero remains the number zero.
ewma.imputation_rule: Replace None/NaN with that head column's fit-time median, then apply the fitted center and scale.
ewma.missingness_indicator_usage: No additional missingness column for these EWMA values; median replacement is the indirect path.
ewma.fallback_or_refusal: Retain explicit missing state and native research imputation; no invented team form. A feature declaration does not certify the missingness pattern or approve fallback use for official selections.

cfb_rest.source: Earlier canonical last-game timestamps for both FBS teams.
cfb_rest.freshness_requirement: Use only the bound package source/cutoff and TTL policy, with earlier eligible histories and no future fitted state. A current retrieval timestamp does not establish current sporting coverage.
cfb_rest.missing_representation: If either team has no last-game timestamp, rest difference is None; a valid zero difference remains observed zero.
cfb_rest.imputation_rule: Compute home minus away integer elapsed days when both exist; otherwise each head substitutes its own fit-time median.
cfb_rest.missingness_indicator_usage: No dedicated rest-missing indicator; the head-specific imputation is an indirect path.
cfb_rest.fallback_or_refusal: Retain null raw difference and imputed value separately; missing acquisition cannot establish no games. A feature declaration does not certify the missingness pattern or approve fallback use for official selections.

schedule_flags.source: Normalized canonical CFB event neutral-site and conference-game fields.
schedule_flags.freshness_requirement: Use only the bound package source/cutoff and TTL policy, with earlier eligible histories and no future fitted state. A current retrieval timestamp does not establish current sporting coverage.
schedule_flags.missing_representation: The forecast requires normalized fields; a normalized false may inherit an upstream omission and needs raw provenance.
schedule_flags.imputation_rule: Convert existing booleans to numeric flags; None/NaN at the packed head uses its fit-time median.
schedule_flags.missingness_indicator_usage: No separate indicator of provider omission; an unverified normalized flag stays unresolved.
schedule_flags.fallback_or_refusal: Expose source-state limitation and keep receipt HOLD until the exact feature/product scope is reviewed. A feature declaration does not certify the missingness pattern or approve fallback use for official selections.

home_for.definition: Home earlier scoring-for state blended toward the fitted league prior.

home_against.definition: Home earlier scoring-against state blended toward the fitted league prior.

away_for.definition: Away earlier scoring-for state blended toward the fitted league prior.

away_against.definition: Away earlier scoring-against state blended toward the fitted league prior.

home_rest.definition: Home elapsed days from last eligible start, bounded to 0–14, with a 14-day absent-history fallback.

away_rest.definition: Away elapsed days from last eligible start, bounded to 0–14, with a 14-day absent-history fallback.

home_cold.definition: Indicator that the home team has fewer than ten earlier eligible games.

away_cold.definition: Indicator that the away team has fewer than ten earlier eligible games.

neutral.definition: Numeric normalized neutral-site flag; upstream missingness is not identifiable from false alone.

elo_diff_with_home_advantage.definition: Season-regressed home Elo plus venue-dependent home advantage minus season-regressed away Elo.

home_ewma_points_for.definition: Home exponentially weighted earlier points scored.

home_ewma_points_against.definition: Home exponentially weighted earlier points conceded.

away_ewma_points_for.definition: Away exponentially weighted earlier points scored.

away_ewma_points_against.definition: Away exponentially weighted earlier points conceded.

home_ewma_margin.definition: Home exponentially weighted earlier scoring margin.

away_ewma_margin.definition: Away exponentially weighted earlier scoring margin.

rest_days_diff.definition: Home elapsed whole days since last game minus away elapsed whole days, missing if either timestamp is absent.

neutral_site.definition: Numeric normalized neutral-site flag consumed by both fitted heads.

conference_game.definition: Numeric normalized conference-game flag consumed by both fitted heads.
